description: Source file defining Slack account resolution logic, including account merging, token resolution, and account listing functions.

methods.name: mergeSlackAccountConfig
methods.description: Merges Slack account configuration with global settings based on account ID.

methods.name: resolveSlackAccount
methods.description: Resolves a Slack account's full configuration, including tokens and settings, based on provided parameters.

methods.name: listEnabledSlackAccounts
methods.description: Returns a list of all enabled Slack accounts based on current configuration.

methods.name: resolveSlackReplyToMode
methods.description: Determines the reply-to mode for a Slack account based on chat type and account settings.
